data.name: Sanketraj
data.gender_notes: Sanketraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sanketraj is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘संकेत्’ (Sanket) which means ‘sound, message, warning, signal, omen, or a sign’. The suffix ‘Raj’ is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘राज’ (Raj) which means ‘king, ruler, or a monarch’. The name Sanketraj carries the meaning “Sound, Thunder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sanketraj usually hope their child will grow to embody sound, thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sanketraj signifies the sound of the universe, which is a call from the divine to pay attention and listen carefully to the messages and signs that are being communicated.
data.etymology: Sanketraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sound, Thunder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sanketraj total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

It is a Hindu name that evokes a strong sense of leadership, wisdom, and the ability to foresee events before they occur. A person named Sanketraj is often seen as a trusted advisor and a guardian of the community, who uses their keen understanding of signs and omens to guide and protect those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sanketraj carries a deep spiritual significance in Hinduism, as it represents the connection between the physical world and the divine realm. The sound, message, or warning delivered by Sanketraj is believed to be a divine communication from the gods, guiding the person towards the right path. It symbolizes the importance of staying attuned to the signs and omens around us, and using that knowledge to serve others and fulfill our spiritual purpose in life.

historical_references.reference: Sanketraj is a title given to the head of the Sanketik branch of the Bhagat family in medieval India. The Sanketiks were a prominent clan in the Bhagat community, which was a Jain lay-community known for its role in trade and commerce. Sanketraj is believed to have ruled during the 14th and 15th centuries.
